subject: Invoicing & net terms for BlueLeaf EU subsidiary
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@blueleaf.tech>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueLeaf Finance <finance@blueleaf.tech>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Net60 for BlueLeaf EU B.V. + VAT invoice routing and increased credit limit

Hi Grace,

Quick ask as we ramp into a heavier usage period next quarter: can Redwood bill our EU entity (BlueLeaf EU B.V.) with VAT-inclusive invoices and grant Net60 payment terms for the first 90 days? Our procurement/legal needs the invoices addressed to the EU entity (VAT ID below) so they can process locally.

Additionally, we're anticipating consumption to spike and would like a temporary credit increase to $120,000 for the next quarter (to be reviewed after 90 days). If you need a PO or any evidence (SOC2, KYC), we can provide what you need.

Billing details:
- Billing entity: BlueLeaf EU B.V.
- VAT ID: NL123456789B01
- Invoice contact: finance@blueleaf.tech
- PO contact: procurement@blueleaf.tech

Please let me know what information you need from our side and whether Redwood can make an exception to Net60 for the EU entity while we scale.

Thanks,
Oliver Hayes
Head of Platform Ops
BlueLeaf Technologies
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@blueleaf.tech>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for BlueLeaf EU B.V. + VAT invoice routing and increased credit limit

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear note. Appreciate the heads-up on ramp.

Short answer: we can accommodate the EU invoicing and VAT routing to BlueLeaf EU B.V., and we have a couple of flexible approaches for the Net terms / credit increase. To keep things operational while protecting both sides, here are two options we commonly use:

Option A (preferred): Net45 rolling, with signed PO on file and a short-term credit increase to $120,000 for 90 days. This keeps cashflow predictable while we validate actual usage against the forecast.

Option B: Net60 for the first 30 days if BlueLeaf can post a $20,000 prepayment / retainer that will be applied to invoices, then revert to Net45 thereafter.

We will need:
- Signed PO (PDF or PO number) referencing account BL-485
- Confirmed billing name and VAT ID (you provided — NL123456789B01)
- The invoice recipient email for electronic delivery (finance@blueleaf.tech is fine)

I’m looping in Karthik from Finance and Marissa from Account Management to handle the paperwork and temporary credit addendum. I’ve attached a short VAT routing doc and a SOC2 summary that procurement often requests.

If you prefer, we can approve the temporary credit increase immediately upon receipt of the signed PO and a contact at procurement to expedite. Which option would you prefer?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: Redwood_VAT_Instructions.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@blueleaf.tech>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for BlueLeaf EU B.V. + VAT invoice routing and increased credit limit

Hi Oliver — Karthik from Finance here.

We can provisionally approve a temporary credit increase to $120,000 for a 90-day period under these conditions:
1) We receive a signed PO or a formal purchase order number referencing Redwood account BL-485.
2) BlueLeaf agrees to standard payment remediation (30-day escalation to collections) if payments fall past agreed SLOs during the provisional window.
3) We receive company billing entity confirmation and VAT ID (you provided this; please confirm legal name exactly as it should appear on invoices).

If those are acceptable, Finance will issue a short addendum documenting the temporary limit and the review date (90 days). Please ensure the PO includes the billing address below so we can produce EU-compliant invoices:
BlueLeaf EU B.V.
Straatweg 12
1012 AB Amsterdam
Netherlands

We also support reverse-charge VAT handling on our invoices where applicable; if you want us to apply reverse charge (no VAT on Redwood invoice), confirm that BlueLeaf EU B.V. will handle VAT via their local tax return and provide the VAT registration printout.

I’ve attached a draft temporary credit addendum for your review. Once the signed PO and PO number are in, we’ll finalize and activate the increase.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: temporary_credit_addendum.docx
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@blueleaf.tech>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueLeaf Finance <finance@blueleaf.tech>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for BlueLeaf EU B.V. + VAT invoice routing and increased credit limit

Thanks Grace / Karthik — quick replies below.

We’re good to proceed with Option B (one-month $20k retainer + Net60 for month one, then Net45 ongoing) provided the temporary increase to $120k is documented. Procurement will issue a PO this morning: PO# BL-PO-78291 for the provisional limit and initial retainer.

Billing confirmation:
- Billing entity: BlueLeaf EU B.V. (exact legal name confirmed)
- VAT ID: NL123456789B01 (confirmed)
- Billing address: Straatweg 12, 1012 AB Amsterdam, Netherlands
- Invoice delivery: finance@blueleaf.tech

We will also attach a VAT registration printout to the PO email so you can apply reverse-charge if that is simpler on your side. Expect the signed PO and the $20k wire details by EOD today.

Please send over the addendum and the final invoice template so our AP team can reconcile quickly. Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we expect usage to ramp materially (to ~250k/month) and will re-evaluate formal credit facilities after the 90-day review.

—Oliver
